document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
A peeling but sturdy-looking vessel rests beside the pier. It is 
the Kyonas. On deck, you see a sign: “SHIP FOR HIRE - see 
Capt. Miko Rduka.” If you want a secret way to leave Greece, this 
might be it. Rduka, the half Armenian and half Greek captain, 
will take you anywhere in the Mediterranean. It takes 24 hours 
to get the vessel loaded, fueled, and crewed.
If Christos is with you, go to 78 and then return here.
If you hire the Kyonas, you sail at this time the next day, and 
reach Alexandria exactly 48 hours later, go to 195; otherwise 
return to the Athens Location Table.
(Athens Location)
